findings_qualitative.value: Masers coexist in six sources and avoid each other in four; no link to evolutionary stage

evidence.quote: we do not notice a relationship between the phase of the evolution of YSO and the presence of regions with coexistence or avoidance of methanol and ex-OH masers

claims.hypothesis: Maser coexistence/avoidance reflects local gas/dust temperature and density
claims.experiment: Compare e-MERLIN maser positions with Cragg et al. models and Zeeman-derived densities
claims.result: Coincidence for cloudlets within 205 au; four pairs with n>10^8.3 show no coexistence
claims.finding: Avoidance relates to local temperature/density changes on hundreds of au

evidence.quote: Where the lines show avoidance, this can be related to changes in dust and gas temperatures; we also found a few examples suggestive of a high gas density.

claims.hypothesis: Magnetic field direction is related to outflow direction
claims.experiment: Compare field PA from linear polarization with outflow PA, KS test

evidence.quote: We did not obtain consistent results regarding the direction of the magnetic field and outflow.

evidence.quote: To trace outflows, and in particular the outflow direction, which is interesting to compare to the magnetic field orientation, we used 22 GHz water masers and archival ALMA
